svg.text: Rooftop rainwater harvesting for Delhi · plan → ask → apply → install → monsoon check · serverless on AWS
C · SERVERLESS RUNTIME · AWS LAMBDA (PYTHON 3.12 · ARM64)
logs · errors never shown to users
Find the building: address → Amazon Location → outline the roof on the map
Plan: Open-Meteo rainfall + Delhi rules → litres, structure size, cost, subsidy → DynamoDB
Ask Boond: Bedrock Nova Lite agent (Strands) with 6 plan-scoped tools, English / Hindi
Apply: application PDF + QR certificate in S3 → Jal Board officer reviews (nearby water via OSM)
Install & check: photo uploaded to S3 → Bedrock vision verdict: healthy · needs cleaning · broken
Ward view: footprints + plans → ward dashboard and what-if simulation
Every day: EventBridge → Reminders λ → SNS email before the monsoon
Legend: solid = runtime data path · dashed = browser uploads straight to S3 with a presigned URL · colours follow AWS service categories
